roles_en: Minister of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Թիֆլիս՝ 1875-ին։ Մանկավարժ, գրող եւ Դաշնակցութեան ղեկավար, Պէյրութի Ճեմարանի հիմնադիրներէն, մահացած է 1947-ին։
bio_en: Nikol Aghbalian was born in Tiflis on 24 March 1875 and studied at the Nersisian school, the Gevorgian seminary and the universities of Moscow and Lausanne. A teacher in Kaghzvan, Agulis, Shushi and Tiflis, he later directed Armenian schools in Tehran and Alexandria; an active ARF member from 1904, he represented the Bureau in Kars (1904-05) and Egypt, and was one of the leaders of the volunteer movement in 1914-17. He was a member of the Armenian National Bureau and of the parliament of the Republic of Armenia, and was jailed by the Bolsheviks in February 1921. In exile he founded the Armenian Seminary (Jemaran) in Beirut with Levon Shant and taught there until his death on 17 August 1947.
